title: Bardic Inspiration (Condition)
html:
This article is about the condition. For items that interact with it, see Bard set. For other uses, see Bardic Inspiration (disambiguation).

Bardic Inspiration

  • Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to the next  Attack Roll,  Ability Check, or  Saving Throw.
  • Bonus depends on originating Bard's level

Properties

 Stack ID: BARDIC_INSPIRATION

 Stack priority: 0

Grants:

 Bardic Attack ()
Add a +1d6 bonus to your  Attack Roll.
 Bardic Defence
Add a +1d6 bonus to your  Saving Throw.
Bardic Roll
Add a +1d6 bonus to your next Ability Check.

Sources of Bardic Inspiration

  • Bardic Inspiration (class action)

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID BARDIC_INSPIRATION, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Bardic Inspiration
  • Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to the next  Attack Roll,  Ability Check, or  Saving Throw.
  • Bonus depends on originating Bard's level
Combat Inspiration
  • Can use their Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to their next  Attack Roll,  Ability Check, or  Saving Throw.
  • They can also choose a +1d6 bonus to the damage their next weapon attack deals, or to their  Armour Class for one attack
  • Bonus depends on the originating Bard's level
Improved Bardic Inspiration
  • Can use  Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d12 bonus to the next  Attack Roll,  Ability Check, or  Saving Throw.
